name: Daryl McCormack
bio: Daryl McCormack (born January 22, 1993) is an Irish actor. He has appeared in the RTÉ One soap opera Fair City (2015–2016), the BBC series Peaky Blinders (2019–2022), and the Apple TV+ series Bad Sisters (2022). His films include Pixie (2019) and Good Luck to You, Leo Grande (2022).
